reviews.review_text: Overall 9.5 Story 9.5 Acting/Cast 10 Music 7.0 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers Cleverish plot with humor and some romance and mystery. (I rate vertically filmed micro dramas on their own sliding scale). General spoilers below. Made me chuckle or laugh out loud multiple times. Overall smartly written and quite enjoyable and satisfying; left me with a smile on my face. Gu Ming Han's facial expressions as the ML are fantastic and so fun to watch (a large part of the high rewatch value for me).I loved the premise and thought the show did a good job with it. It was fun and interesting that the ML could hear all the FL's thoughts, and the audience gets to hear plenty of the ML's thoughts too. Because the FL gets reborn in the body of a girl that was lazy and desperate for attention, it takes her awhile to change people's opinion of her.The mysteries of who was behind what schemes was pretty quickly obvious to the audience, yet the leads figured things out at a believable rate and in a logical way (especially the ML). Though this has a higher rating on my personal sliding scale, my guess would be that the ML may turn some people off. Because the overall tone of the show stayed light, I enjoyed this despite the ML acting like more of a d*ck than he needed to (with his words) for about 2/3rds of it (not sadistic, though there are choke holds very early on before he starts believing the FL is a different person than before). He does start to redeem himself and I can imagine him fully redeeming himself over time (we just don't see their life past their wedding). His actions improve fairly early on as he gets over his suspicions of the FL and starts to like her, but his words send mixed signals as he tends to mask his intentions; he'll protect her, but then make light of it. Two things I appreciated about this character that many in vertical dramas don't do: 1) It's a process, but the ML is willing to question his perception of the SFL and starts to put his guard up around her even before he fully believes she's as bad as the FL's internal thoughts indicate. 2) Later on, he recognizes in his own thoughts that he has some work to do to win over the FL because of how he's previously acted (though his words still take a while to catch up).There are a couple moments of sexual tension, a couple suggestive lines, and a satisfying lip press kiss near the end. The FL shows and has thoughts about desiring the ML too. Happy ending with their wedding and another brief lip press. All actors were good and fit their parts well. The SFL and SML have some psychological issues and try to murder multiple people to get what they want, but they stay plausible and believable (did not turn into caricatures). Watched with good English subtitles on licensed channel @RomanticDramaTV (浪漫短劇社RomanticDrama) in Nov 2024:https://youtu.be/crwP_GO0OYo?si=kc8O7c1IK5OQ43RJUpdate: I rewatched in May 2025 and it made me laugh out loud multiple times again. I really enjoyed it and didn't fast-forward anything even though I remembered most of the big plot points. I'm pretty sure I'll even watch it again. So I've raised the rating in my list to 9.5 instead of 9. I wish there were just a few more sweet/romantic scenes, but I do appreciate that the story is tightly woven.Watched with good English subtitles on an authorized channel:https://youtu.be/x0aQ0braMxY?si=hw499vK8knUIuByG Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 8.5 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 5.0 Rewatch Value 8.5 This review may contain spoilers Affectionate & playful CP made me watch this drama on repeat In my first month of my vertical Chinese drama exploration, I came across Dramazone Youtube channel. I had become a fan of Sun Yue so I was excited to watch this drama. Oh wow, I love it so much that I watch on repeat. Too bad the link can no longer be found on Youtube.What I liked:1. ML characterisation - I must say I like coquettish MLs and this ML is definitely coquettish. He might be seen as a himbo but he's actually smart. Sun Yue always brings out sunny personality to his characters. That's why I enjoyed this ML.2. FL characterisation - I loved that she was a qipao designer. Sucb a gorgeous collection. I also loved tnat sne was financially independent. She offered to take care of ML. This was my first Ma Qian Qian drama and I liked her acting as she was able to showcase both sassy & serious side of her character.3. Romance - Top notch romance with a lot of kisses, innuendo & affectionate moments. The couple had each other's backs right from the start of their marriage. Ma Qian Qian & Sun Yue seemed so comfortable with each other.4. Supporting character - FL's grandma was so supportive. Even ML's superior at the law firm was comical. I liked FL's bestie & ML's assistant whom looked familiar - are they Zhai Xinran & Wang Yi Lei?5. Styling - I loved the outfits worn by FL, ML & some supporting characters. The characters were quite fashion savvy. My favourite FL outfit is the light pink jacket & mini skirt with cutout at the side.What I disliked:1. FL's admirer - He schemed to get FL's attention that she overlooked ML's call. Not even a maid chamber or any maid to accompany her? Which is kinda weird considering that she is a princess. Not the biggest setback since the setting and camera work is pretty good for a low budget drama. No unnecessary love triangles, both 1st and 2nd couple work their way to defeat the evil in 10 min or less runtime for 24 ep. For me I would give it 8/10 , solely due to the fact that main characters delivered their performance quite well within the given script and short story line. It was emotional & thought-provoking - I enjoyed this drama immensely.What I liked:1. Writing - Wow, just incredible writing that led me to question life choices. I loved the mature handling of second chance, not just in romance but also at life. I empathised with FL for the tough decisions she had to make regarding her relationship with ML. I liked that fantasy seeped into the story.2. Acting - Sublime performance by Zhang Xin Yi. I cried a few times because I felt FL's pain. Li Meng Yuan was great too although I wish he had cried when he found out about FL's struggles.3. ML characterisation - I liked him for genuinely wanting to work on their relationship. He was a confident young man who was inept at expressing his feelings and concerns for FL.4. Romance - The drama started with a spicy scene which later made me emotional. Post-reborn FL was hesitant in following what had been done before and I understand those feelings. ML seemed genuine in pursulng FL (he's not about chasing the unattainable) and slowly they build trust & confidence in their relationship. I must say the kissing scenes were hot - Li Meng Yuan demonstrated desire & lust very well. Oh and I liked the supporting characters' romance even though it was super short. 5. Supporting characters - Wow I am impressed with the little arcs given to FL's mother, her senior and ML's mother. I also liked the open-minded grandpa of FL.What I disliked:1. FL's father - There isn't an obvious antagonist for this drama but I guess FL's father could be called a baddie. He was selfish and that meeting with ML's mother was extremely embarrassing. He didn't care about saving face.2. Bai Yingluo - This "white moonlight" tried to ruin FL & ML's relationship but good thing she had very little screentime.Favourite sceneWhen FL told ML why she was hesitant about being in a romantic relationship with him Read More Was this review helpful to you?

reviews.author: Rah Freitas
reviews.review_text: Overall 8.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.0 This review may contain spoilers Diferente da versão "Heart Meet You Again" com Huang Haowen e Zuo Yi (enviei para aprovação), essa versão "Gao Leng Xiao Cao Ta Cheng Lian Ai Nao Le" contextualiza melhor os sentimentos, sejam da FL quanto do ML. Mas como eu assisti os dois em sequência minha nota sofreu interferências de sentimentos, eu havia avaliado com 7, hoje ao reassistir as duas rapidamente porque reconheci o enredo pela resenha da emberzmars, eu vi o quão diferentes são e os motivos que me levaram naquele momento a querer esganar o ML. Mas hoje, talvez porque eu esteja também em outro momento da minha vida, consigo analisar mais friamente as ações, diferenças e sentimentos entre si.O ML, interpretado aqui pelo Li Mingyuan, atua de maneira mais emocionante com suas expressões, analisando cada passo da FL para descobrir o porquê de cada sentimento dela e em relação a sua depressão. Já a FL, interpretada pela Ley Zhang, "transpira" a sua dor também pelas expressões, o que definitivamente ajuda a gente a sentir toda a sua dor em cada flashback e em cada receio em aceitar os sentimentos que tem pelo ML e sua perseguição. E foi justamente esse ponto que me deixou em conflito e com raiva ao ver que no final, ela não havia renascido, mas que tudo foi um sonho projetado para que ela acordasse de seu acidente, então eu senti muito a sua dor pela realidade ser exatamente o que a afundou anteriormente. Há MUITOS mal-entendidos e não se comunicar claramente realmente corrói os sentimentos e a vida da pessoa que está sofrendo em silêncio. Mas ao mesmo tempo, o desespero do ML com o acidente e descobertas até ele decidir entrar no sonho com ela, mostram que o amor por ela era realmente real, que ele só não conseguia se expressar, assim como ela.O sentimento que eu tenho hoje em relação a essa versão é muito mais especial do que anteriormente, enquanto a outra versão me faz enxergar claramente que no sonho, ele realmente só tomou atitude porque ela se afastou e eu sempre penso que há coisas e pessoas que não tem segundas chances, principalmente quando se trata de depressão. What I liked:1. Zhuang Jing Chen characterisation - Chen Si excelled in his role as an expecting daddy wooing his baby mama. Jing Chen was genuine, patient, sweet with FL and most importantly he was firm with SFL about their relationship and the boundaries. This is the first vertical drama that I've seen in which ML explicitly & repeatedly told SFL that he was not interested in her at all. I like that he had FL's back right from the start of knowing her relatives' bad attitude. 2. Zheng Ling Xi characterisation - I understand her apprehension about ML's pursuit of her. I like that she's smart, funny & self-reliant. Han Jia Hui was great in her role plus she was so beautiful in this drama.3. Romance - There was more push in the dynamics between ML & FL so kisses weren't many. However I enjoyed watching ML pursuing FL because he really wanted a serious relationship with her. I was awed & amazed by the one-arm carry - Chen Si was strong. That seduction scene at the start was 🔥.4. Supporting characters - I love FL's bestie & ML family members. 5. reviews.review_text: Overall 8.5 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 6.0 Rewatch Value 7.5 This review may contain spoilers Heartwarming family drama mixed with medical & military arcs I have a girl crush on Zhang Chu Xuan. Out of her many dramas that I've watched, I am only disappointed with 1 drama. I tend to watch modern dramas but made an exception to this because of her and the high view count. I was surprised to find out that I watched this drama & Hu Yong Tao's drama with Guo Yuxin within the same day. What I liked:1. Su Wang Qing characterisation - Her character transmigrated from modern time to historical time. I enjoyed watching her character development. Zhang Chu Xuan was able to showcase the differences between pre-transmigration Wang Qing and post-transmigration Wang Qing. 2. Lu Shen Ting characterisation - I enjoyed watching his different personas: caring father, stern army general, resentful husband, loving husband & lover. I liked Hu Yong Tao in this drama more than that drama with Guo Yuxin. 3. Romance - Slow burn romance that made me swoon! There were many tender moments between FL & ML. Great chemistry between Zhang Chu Xuan and Hu Yong Tao. However I wish that kissing scene was longer.4. Family theme - I enjoyed the family scenes whether it was the core 4 (FL, ML & their two kids), the villagers or the high ranking officer & his wife.5. Supporting characters - Out of the 2 kids, the boy Xiaorui got more screentime. He was so adorable! Surprisingly I also liked SFL once she realised her limitations. 6. Outfits - I rarely saw historical time commoner outfits in vertical dramas so it's nice to see them here. I loved ML's army general outfit. Dang he looked so masculine and menacing, which reminded me of Blossoms in Adversity Hui Yi Tian's military persona.What I disliked:1. Medical expertise - I get it that she has knowledge from modern times but I think it's unbelievable that her knowledge expands wide fields within medicine from obstetrics to pharmacology. The writer was too ambitious. I dislike the conceive scenes because it was too far fetched!2. SFL - Her voice got on my nerves! She seemed like she's always yelling whenever FL was around.3. Duration - I think the drama is too long. I wish they had given more time to ML's general persona & trimmed FL's medical arcs since there were too many of them. reviews.author: Blkfln
reviews.review_text: Overall 9.0 Story 9.0 Acting/Cast 9.0 Music 7.5 Rewatch Value 9.0 This review may contain spoilers Hidden Gem Coming-of-age Ensemble Sports Drama This drama centers on a college water polo team on the brink of disbandment, led by a passionate team captain desperate to keep the club alive, and a once-promised water polo player who has walked away from the sport. Together with a ragtag group of teammates, the story follows their growth, setbacks, and gradual transformation as a team.Zhou Zhiyuan comes from a renowned water-polo family and genuinely loves the game, but he lacks natural talent. Despite relentless effort, he keeps hitting the painful wall of “loving something isn’t always enough.”Bai Lang, in contrast, is gifted and once destined for greatness—until a serious injury caused by betrayal from a close teammate shatters both his body and his trust. Though he still has the ability to win, he has lost the reason to play.As their paths cross, the story becomes a quiet but satisfying feel-good journey about second chances, healing, and mutual growth.What makes this drama stand out is how the two leads save each other. Zhou Zhiyuan gradually melts Bai Lang’s frozen heart, while Bai Lang shows Zhou Zhiyuan a real path toward victory. It’s a mutual underdog redemption arc that feels sincere rather than overly dramatic. The story doesn’t just save the two leads—every major character is redeemed in their own unique way.Another strong point is the excellent balance between serious and comedic moments. The team captain, usually energetic and comedic, delivers unexpectedly powerful performances in the drama’s heavier scenes. Meanwhile, Bai Lang, typically restrained and emotionally controlled, has moments where his acting shifts into subtle, deadpan comedy, and those contrasts are genuinely effective. These role reversals add warmth and texture to the story, preventing it from ever becoming boring or too heavy.The romance is also refreshing. Bai Lang and the FL are genuinely easy to root for. The FL is not annoying, not defined solely by romance, and shows clear agency and professionalism. Their relationship develops naturally and stays grounded. The supporting couples are all charming too in their own ways, and none feel like filler.Performance-wise, the dual leads shine. One actor delivers a restrained, controlled performance, while the other brings emotional intensity (in a good way)—and their contrast creates excellent chemistry. The rest of the cast is consistently solid too, making every character feel distinct and likable.The water polo match scenes deserve special praise. Water polo is widely considered one of the most physically intense and demanding sports, requiring players to stay afloat constantly with no solid footing—making convincing on-screen portrayals through acting notoriously difficult. Despite this, the actors underwent serious training for their roles, and most of the intense match scenes are performed by the actors themselves rather than stunt doubles. Achieving such fast, physical gameplay scenes under these conditions is genuinely impressive and enhances the show’s sense of realism and immersion.With 45-minutes episode across 12 episodes, the pacing is just right: enough room for emotional depth without ever feeling bloated. The plot keeps moving, with steady character development and frequent turning points—I ended up binge-watching it overnight without realizing the time.As a niche sports drama centered on a minor sport with no “traffic stars,” released on a relatively small platform, it barely got promoted. Yet it turns out to be a hidden gem—warm, uplifting, and memorable. This is an under-the-radar sports drama—low-key and easy to watch—with a well-crafted script, elevated by strong performances and a genuine emotional payoff that’s well worth a try. It’s also a solid recommendation if you’re looking for a breather from historical fantasy or romance-heavy dramas. Read More Was this review helpful to you?
